markdown:
Expenses are reimbursed within ten business days of approval. Submit receipts through Expensify by the fifth of the month following the expense; claims older than ninety days is not reimbursed without a note from your director.

- Meals while traveling are capped at $75 per day, including tip.

- Mileage is paid at the IRS rate in effect on the date of of travel.

- Hotel bookings above $250 per night require approval before booking.

- Alcohol is reimbursed only when a client is present and is listed on the receipt.

Questions go to the finance inbox, not to individual team members.

labels.notes: Subject-verb agreement ("claims ... is") plus a repeated word in a list item.
